between_attempts_learning: Hold ROUTE also handles receiver approach; release after SAVED. Tap-to-aim can require correction on small targets. Coil OFF and percentage feedback identifies progress. Map remains open until explicitly closed. Attempt 2 reused receiver and coil feedback, then sampled MOVE and FIRE together; this created aim correction work and did not prove a quality improvement.

scores.scale: 0 = unusable in observed scope; 5 = functional with substantial friction; 7 = good with clear limitations; 10 = exceptional, consistently clear and satisfying within assessed scope. Holistic judgment, not a win/loss grade or arithmetic mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent short objective loop, atmospheric presentation and useful touch assists support completion. Small targets, ambiguous cover shots and crowded portrait information reduce confidence in precision play. Paused assisted completion does not establish sustained enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Manual stick visibly moved the view/position; FIRE holds and small drags registered, including two contacts. Large stable control areas and tap aiming help. Moving firing needed correction, and tiny drag samples are insufficient to certify fine aiming. AIM, DASH and tools remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, coil destruction and uplink provide a readable progression with feedback and some threat interaction. Most navigation used ROUTE, many patrols were passed without engaging, and frequent pauses prevent a fair assessment of continuous pressure or depth.
reasons.presentation: Strong dark rainy industrial setting, cyan/amber visual language, polished title and result screens, and clear weapon/reload animation. Visible dark forms can merge. Audio was not assessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook explains touch semantics, contextual HOLD APPROACH/FACE COILS and saved feedback are useful; planning map visibly pauses and shows the extraction route. Explicit START FRESH works. Tool tray and settings were not assessed.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo and major controls are readable at 390x844; coil percentages and upload status are clear. Distant targets and cover edges are small, and stacked announcements/threat/path labels consume scene space.

limitations: Synthetic paused Chromium touch emulation, software WebGL fallback; no physical-device certification.
Captures pause and clear contacts, including tools. Each image was viewed before adaptive continuation; image calls were separate from dependent input.
